go_oob_experiment.purpose: Probe whether a caller can forge inherited PWD during relative /bin/sh launcher execution so SELF_PATH=$PWD/$0 resolves sibling guard state in an attacker-selected directory.
go_oob_experiment.intervention: Run a relative shell probe from a real directory while injecting PWD pointing at a separate fake directory containing a same-named probe.
go_oob_experiment.baseline_expected: SELF_PATH follows the real current working directory.
go_oob_experiment.counterworld_expected: If inherited PWD is trusted, SELF_PATH follows the fake directory and resolves the wrong inode.

observed.resolved_inode: real probe inode in both cases

limitations: not executed on accepted target VPS
does not prove all shell implementations normalize PWD identically
does not close the productive service/root-anchor gate

next_falsifier: Read-only productive service inventory followed, only if an actual production parent is identified and authority permits, by exact V5 end-to-end admission/restart receipt. If no production parent/anchor exists, remain fail closed and treat provisioning as the blocker rather than adding more candidate guards.
